artifacts.synopsis: TE Frazier complained that Nashville Presbytery erred in finding insufficient evidence to raise a strong presumption of guilt against TE Scott Sauls regarding his teaching on same-sex attraction; the SJC denied the complaint 20-0-1, concluding NP fulfilled its BCO 31-2 investigatory duties, accompanied by several concurring opinions raising procedural and exegetical concerns.

artifacts.title: Presbytery authority to judge theonomy as heresy under WCF 19-4

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a presbytery retains the right to examine and judge a man heretical on WCF 19-4 grounds, provided the error is demonstrated by specific evidence.
